<!-- What this changes, and why. Link the issue it resolves. -->

- [ ] A test that failed before this change; a new scenario comes with a fixture
- [ ] Unit tests, typecheck, lint, formatting and licence scan pass; conformance suites too, if a model,
      format or commerce package changed
- [ ] Synthetic data only — no real invoice, name, address, VAT-ID or bank details
- [ ] Docs under `docs/` updated for any changed contract or behaviour
- [ ] A changeset, if users of a published package will notice the change

The full list is in `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
